question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a white ball, Bob has a green ball, and Claire has a red ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Bob and Alice swap balls. Then, Bob and Claire swap balls. Finally, Claire and Bob swap balls. At the end of the game, Alice has the
Options:
(A) white ball
(B) green ball
(C) red ball
solution:
Each row lists ball colors in this order: Alice, Bob, Claire.
Initial: white, green, red
1. Bob and Alice swap: green, white, red
2. Bob and Claire swap: green, red, white
3. Claire and Bob swap: green, white, red
Alice has the green ball, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
